layout.SKILL.md, assets/, recorder/, reference/: Imported upstream snapshot with the Two Hours recorder integration listed below

excluded: upstream promotional media, website and tests
version_note: 0.5.0 is the upstream plugin metadata version. The original 24-file snapshot matched this commit; the current Two Hours adaptations are listed in local_modifications.

verification.original_import: The original imported snapshot matched upstream; LICENSE and upstream assets remain unchanged.
verification.syntax: All 10 Python scripts parse; Swift typecheck and a native arm64 build pass.
verification.tests: 75 repository unit tests pass, including deterministic append-during-consumption checks for native, headless and Tk paths, plus a compiled test of the actual Swift command reader.
verification.isolated_home: Built and codesign --verify --strict verified Two Hours.app in an isolated filesystem HOME without independent Blurt files. Temporary upstream icons were test fixtures, not final branding.
verification.final_brand: Rebuilt and installed the final Two Hours.app from the installed skill with the approved 2h app icon and 16/32px menu templates. Strict signature verification and LaunchServices --diagnose passed; bundled menu assets match the canonical brand files.
verification.launchservices: open -n -W with --diagnose returned Two Hours / dev.twohours.recorder / parent_pid=1 without starting capture.
verification.permissions: Real clean-macOS first authorization and actual screen/microphone capture were not tested.
verification.command_log: All command writers append newline-delimited commands; consumers retain offsets and partial lines without deleting or truncating the log. Swift typecheck passes after this repair.
verification.recording_recovery: Synthetic native writer tests exercise continuous/static video, absent audio buffers, two audio tracks with one empty, no-mic and pause-adjusted timestamps. External SIGKILL files and recovered copies strictly decode. Audio tests check 440 Hz and duration across int16/float32, interleaved/planar, mono/stereo and 44.1/48 kHz, including partial late samples and 1024-frame packets. No real screen or microphone capture was started.
verification.windows: 2026-11-01: native Tk screen and microphone capture (10.36 seconds), Chinese local SenseVoice transcription and frame extraction passed. Synthetic tests cover pause/resume/marker/stop, auto-stop, Unicode media paths and preserving failed segments.

local_modifications.scripts/_identity.py: Select bundled Two Hours identity, brand assets, and isolated storage; preserve standalone Blurt defaults.
local_modifications.scripts/_common.py: Use distribution storage and a shared append-only command log reader with byte offsets and partial-line buffering. Windows: discover winget ffmpeg, configure UTF-8 stdio.
local_modifications.scripts/record.py: Build and verify a Two Hours bundle, launch it through LaunchServices, forward file commands, preserve recording events, and reject overwriting existing sessions. Recover interrupted native recordings through a validated remux, retain the original file, reject active/completed/discarded sessions, and report incomplete or missing microphone audio. Windows: safe handle-based process queries, reject unsupported native/system-audio options, reject junction/reparse recovery paths, preserve failed mux sources. Matroska clusters (2026-11-03, from upstream f3f93b0f): the headless ffmpeg engine writes -cluster_time_limit 1000 -flush_packets 1 before the output, so a grabber killed mid-take leaves a file that decodes up to its last second.
local_modifications.scripts/doctor.py: Report the actual recording identity and explain app-specific permissions without requesting them. Windows: probe Tk/PortAudio and declare sounddevice for isolated uv diagnostics.
local_modifications.recorder/macos/BlurtRecorder.swift: Read bundle identity and paths, use distribution labels/icons/notification names, accept command files, and support permission-free identity diagnostics. Selectively port 1.0.2 four-second movie fragments and disabled frame reordering; this does not implement automatic restart or stitching. Keep static video and silent tracks advancing; normalize PCM through AVAudioConverter before filling silence, drain pending media on stop, and retain failed app sessions.
local_modifications.scripts/transcribe.py: Pin a SHA-256 per model download source and discard downloads that do not match (hashes from Hugging Face LFS oids and the GitHub release digest, checked 2026-11-02).
local_modifications.scripts/tk_recorder.py: Consume the shared append-only command log without unlinking files held by concurrent writers. Windows: enforce max duration, retain failed/empty segments, stop on callback errors, include audio frame/overflow telemetry. Windows recording fixes (2026-11-03, from upstream 7dea4480 and f3f93b0f): each Tk segment is written with -cluster_time_limit 1000 -flush_packets 1; finalize passes the concat list and output to ffmpeg without the \\?\ extended-length prefix through a local _plain(), which also turns \\?\UNC\srv\share into \\srv\share.

upstream_inspected.scope: Selectively reviewed upstream recording and annotation changes; the bundled baseline remains 0.5.0.
selected_changes: Use four-second movie fragments and disable video frame reordering, as in the upstream macOS recorder, to improve recoverability after interrupted writing.

7dea4480 (2026-11-02) and f3f93b0f v1.0.12 (2026-11-03), checked 2026-11-03: copied the -cluster_time_limit 1000 -flush_packets 1 output options (upstream record.py grab command, f3f93b0f) into scripts/record.py headless_video_cmd and scripts/tk_recorder.py video_cmd, and the _plain() prefix strip (upstream record.py, 7dea4480) for the concat demuxer. Changed locally: _plain lives in tk_recorder.py and is used by the Tk finalize concat, because upstream applies it only in its segmented FfmpegRecorder and its tk_recorder.py still passes the prefixed path; \\?\UNC\srv\share maps to \\srv\share where upstream returns the relative path UNC\srv\share. Not imported: uv_bin() (2hours has no live.py), capture restart after the grabber exits mid-take, the lock-screen wait and the disk-full handling (separate design ticket), and the Rust/Tauri desktop app.
upstream_inspected.not_imported: The 1.0.2 multi-module application, live/snap/ink flows, segmented writer recovery and standalone review require new protocols and dependencies; they do not replace the existing Two Hours capture and unified review integration.
